policy: All profiles share fresh v5 ingestion, verified lifecycle operations, source erasure, semantic implicit transitions, temporal normalization, a 32-item/6000-token evidence limit and fixed Answer/Judge. Facts disables dedicated raw-source candidates; sources enables them; rerank adds candidate reranking; coverage adds diversity packing. Relation expansion and event projection remain off for this E2/E3 ladder. The verification model judges erasure scope and compatible/exclusive/uncertain implicit transitions using source witness indexes; uncertain relationships preserve both grounded statements as unresolved while erasure authorization remains strict inside the same total 90-second model budget. Reuse ingestion only after every original add succeeds and all source/configuration identity checks pass. No migration or ingestion reuse from older source formats. Exposed development data is regression data, not a new holdout. All failures stay in the planned question denominator; three independent full paired repeats and a new dataset are still required. Source erasure covers at most 256 candidates/256000 candidate characters, partitioned into batches of at most 64 candidates/64000 JSON input characters. All batches share the original deadline and one atomic commit plan; missing or uncertain partitions reject the whole write. The source_erasure_v4 model protocol returns whole-source effects or unique nonoverlapping erase quotes for mixed sources. The server reconstructs and validates the complete original-text partition; uncertain ownership or mixed facts still reject. Exact repeated source and boundary payloads are transmitted once in reference tables; all original fields and candidate relationships remain represented. Batch limits measure actual packed input JSON. Reason categories are fixed and checked against their effect, avoiding verbose repeated explanations without dropping erasure witnesses.
